headline: Xcel Energy Foundation Celebrates 25 Years of Community Investment
summary: MINNEAPOLIS, August 06, 2026--The Xcel Energy Foundation today announced it has invested nearly $160 million over the past quarter of a century to strengthen communities, according to a new Impact Report commemorating the Foundation’s 25th anniversary.
